title: ai_router.learn.v1
description: Learned-reliability report emitted by `router.py --learn --json`. Per-route live outcome statistics collected automatically on every call (opt out per-call with --no-learn; clear with --learn-reset). The overlay only REORDERS routes inside a tier (reliability multiplier clamped to [0.5, 1.2]); it can never disable a route, and cooldowns/state stay authoritative. Records unused for 14 days are pruned.

f429.description: Rate-limit failures observed (weighted 2x when computing reliability).

n.description: Total observations. Reliability is neutral (1.0) until n >= 5.

ewma_s.description: EWMA latency in seconds (alpha 0.25); used to order task=fast.

last_ts.description: Unix timestamp of the last observation (14-day pruning).
